description: Kitchen stove of red brick with lime-plastered top, two arched fire mouths with ember glow, two embedded woks (one with wooden lid), rear chimney, back ledge with seasoning jars and firewood in front.
size_note: 1.7 x 0.95 m body, 0.86 m working height, chimney to 2.2 m.
modeling_method: ten concept sketches drawn first, loaded as reference images, then modelled from the shared design spec; ten views rendered from the same model
